text:
sasha_ml: quick heads-up — Hyperbloom-7B (open weights) q4_0 quant smoke is showing KV-cache divergence on long-context runs. repro below, small logs attached.

sasha_ml: repro command:
```bash
python infra/infer.py --model hyperbloom-7b --quant q4_0 --seq_len 2048 --prompt tests/long_context.txt --dump-kv /tmp/hb_kv
```

sasha_ml: tail of log:
```
ERROR Runtime: kv_cache mismatch at layer 8: max_abs_diff=0.0123
ERROR Runtime: attention output drift > threshold at token 512
```

owen_runtime: thanks. do you have the fp16 baseline diffs for the same prompt? is this only q4_0?

sasha_ml: fp16 baseline -> no mismatch. q8_0 run looks fine. only q4_0 + --use-rotary-fast path trips. quality metrics: long-context rouge drop ~4, ppl +12 compared to fp16. short prompts unaffected.

marco_research: that pattern smells like rotary interpolation + quantization rounding interacting. Hyperbloom uses non-standard RoPE scaling (freq_scale ~1.15) in orig weights. did we preserve the rotary table during quantization?

priya_infra: runtime build info: commit abc1234, kernels: fwd_opt_v3, flags: --use-rotary-fast enabled by default. kernel vendor changed micro-op tiling last week. could be a kernel/implementation mismatch.

owen_runtime: can you run a per-layer layerwise check? we have a small tool:
```bash
python tools/layer_check.py --model hyperbloom-7b --quant q4_0 --layers 6-10 --prompt tests/short_layer_probe.txt
```
that dumps attention matrices and kv per-layer. post output if it reproduces.

sasha_ml: ran layer_check for layers 6-10. layer 8 shows the biggest deltas. snippet:
```
L8: kv_key max_abs_diff=0.0098
L8: kv_value max_abs_diff=0.0119
L8: attn_out max_abs_diff=0.0104
```
legacy-rotary flag (--legacy-rotary) makes diffs go away but latency regresses ~18%.

tara_eval: eval suite (long_context_eval_v2) results: q4_0+rotary-fast drops exact-match 6% vs fp16; q8_0 diff ~0.5%. So q4_0 regression is non-trivial.

marco_research: options: 1) add a small fp16 table for rotary frequencies (keep rotary table in fp16 and only quantize weights) 2) try per-channel quant instead of global (we've seen regression fixes on rotary-sensitive layers) 3) tune quant zero_point/scale with calibration on long-context dataset.

owen_runtime: I'll instrument KV dump for first 12 layers and diff against fp16. also want to try a targeted dequant hook: when computing rotary sin/cos, cast to fp32 temporarily. cheap change to check hypothesis.

priya_infra: note: changing cast behavior may affect throughput. if we do temporary cast in rotary we should measure p99 latencies. we can gate it behind a runtime flag.

sasha_ml: CI job started to collect dumps: hyperbloom7b/kvcache-dump #3421 (ci-bot).

ci-bot: Job #3421 queued. Logs will be posted here when finished.

owen_runtime: initial KV diffs attached from layers 0-11: layers 7-9 are hot. trying the fp16-rotary-table patch now, will push branch hb/rotary-fp16.

marco_research: if fp16-table fixes it, we should add a quantization exception for frequency tables in the quantizer and update quant config for hyperbloom-7b in model-catalog.

tara_eval: prioritization: customer impact = high (long-context app). recommend P1 triage this sprint.

priya_infra: assigning infra/ops review for kernel changelog and perf regression tests after patch.

nowen_runtime: created INF-4327 and assigned to @marco_research + @owen_runtime. I'll post perf numbers and diff artifacts here. :thumbsup:

sasha_ml: thanks — i'll pause any further q4_0 deployments for hyperbloom until we have a fix. keeping thread open for artifacts.

ci-bot: Job #3421 completed. artifacts uploaded: /ci/artifacts/hyperbloom7b/kvcache-dump-3421.tar.gz

nowen_runtime: uploaded quick diff gist and perf numbers. preliminary: fp16-rotary-table patch removes kv diffs to <1e-4 for layers 7-9, latency +6% (acceptable for now). will open PR and add feature-flag.

marco_research: nice. next steps: PR review, add quant exception + update model-catalog entry to mark q4_0 guarded flag, add long-context regression test to nightly.

sasha_ml: awesome. tagging on-call docs and customers impacted. closing triage here once PR merges.
